tasks.BuyCockatoo: Calculate the cost of buying a cockatoo
tasks.BuyPigs: Calculate the cost of buying 8 pot-bellied pigs

Questions.content: What is the task for "AddCosts" and how will it combine the costs from "BuyCockatoo" and "BuyPigs"?

Answers.content:
The task for "AddCosts" is to combine the costs from "BuyCockatoo" and "BuyPigs". Specifically, it will add the cost of buying a cockatoo (which is $70.39) to the total cost of buying 8 pot-bellied pigs ($60.44 each). 

To calculate the total cost for the pigs:
\[ 8 \times \$60.44 = \$483.52 \]

Then, add this amount to the cost of the cockatoo:
\[ \$70.39 + \$483.52 = \$553.91 \]

So, the "AddCosts" task will return a total cost of $553.91 for Wendy to buy a cockatoo and 8 pot-bellied pigs.
